trigger: Stable outside inspection can request a short inward correction. Three stable synchronized ambiguous-clearance captures can request recentering only when height/tilt are plausible, the capsule can fit at the centre, the visual centre error exceeds5mm and observed-support fixture evidence is available. The uncertainty is not relabelled as a proven miss.
feedback: Plan from learned poses/axis and CAD. Move ordinary robot actuators above the rim; during the push stop on the learned centre/clearance goal, fixture motion, missing observations or capsule deviation. Stroke/overtravel, deadlines and attempts are bounded. Retract, open and collect fresh settled visual evidence after every motion; trajectory completion never counts as task success.
controls: Both methods use the same measured-support/top-view worker, frozen networks, 85degree wrist optics, strict containment/stability thresholds, original30s time budget and untouched physics. No target-body writes, attachments or object forces. Contact/force diagnostics remain evaluation-only.
freeze: Register before v20 full episodes. Complete known development first. All unused fresh scenes remain deferred while tuning. Preserve all ablations, failed grasps/pushes and technical attempts.
scope: Development integration after two selected mechanical inward-push successes. This is not established novelty, a hardware safety certificate, calibrated uncertainty or final generalization result.
